headline: Approved new liquor license for Main Street HQ at 198 Main Street, contingent on Fire Marshal approval; also approved two 2027 renewals.
summary: Church Street Tavern and Pascolo Ristorante received 2027 renewals on the consent agenda. All votes were unanimous.
decisions: Approved 2027 First and Third Class Liquor License renewals for Church Street Tavern with all standard conditions, unanimously.
Approved 2027 Outside Consumption Permit renewal for Pascolo Ristorante, unanimously.
Approved 2026-2027 First and Third Class Liquor License applications for Main Street HQ at 198 Main Street, contingent on Fire Marshal approval and standard conditions, unanimously.
